non_authority_statement: Candidate literary/form evidence only. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, locust-or-army identity, fulfillment, chronology, preferred witness/reading/translation/source tradition, graph, retrieval, promotion, or reviewed-gold authority.
routing_principle: Prefer sustained summons-lament, alarm-host, communal return, response-restoration, afterward-oracle, nations-judgment, and Zion-closure movements. Split only at strong address, speaker, summons, response, temporal, scene, or climactic-form seams; preserve lists, refrains, images, and their local rhetorical function.

global_hot_zones.handling: Use form only; defer entity, event, and fulfillment identity.

global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve larger movements; do not atomize imperatives or the quoted plea.

global_hot_zones.issue: The turning statement has temporal/narrative/promissory pressure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Start the response here but keep syntax, timing, and causation LOW/deferred.

global_hot_zones.issue: Rain/teacher and righteousness/just-measure wording is translation-sensitive.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep inside restoration; choose no lexical or theological reading.

global_hot_zones.issue: English and Hebrew chapter numbering differ here.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain WEB coordinates; infer no literary break from either scheme.
Keep complete oracle; decide no identity, fulfillment, doctrine, or later-reuse boundary.

units.title: Superscription and generational summons over devastation
units.literary_form: superscription, memory summons, and loss refrain
units.deciding_marker: The word-event opens direct address; the command to tell reaches its content in the fourfold loss chain.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:1 or detach summons from its content.
units.risk: Names, date, authorship, locust terms, event identity, and historicity remain deferred.

units.title: Widening lament for harvest and vanished joy
units.deciding_marker: Wake-and-wail begins a cumulative circuit; priestly sackcloth starts a new response at verse 13.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each audience, crop, tree, or image.
units.risk: Nation/locust identity, history, metaphor, and causation remain deferred.

units.title: Priestly assembly and cry amid ruined creation
units.literary_form: cultic lament summons, day lament, and prayer
units.deciding_marker: Sackcloth and assembly redirect the poem; day cry, stores, animals, and direct cry complete the response.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 1:15, animals, or first-person cry.
units.risk: Cult, day, speaker, fire, causation, and sequence remain deferred.

units.title: Zion alarm and ordered host before the day
units.literary_form: trumpet alarm, host description, and climactic question
units.deciding_marker: Trumpet launches a continuous host poem culminating in 'who can endure it?'.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split similes, ranks, city penetration, signs, or question; decide no host identity.
units.risk: Host, locust/army, Eden, agency, day, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Return, trumpet, assembly, and priestly plea
units.literary_form: return summons, liturgical call, and quoted intercession
units.deciding_marker: 'Yet even now' pivots to return; the second trumpet gathers all and culminates in the plea.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate formula, 'who knows,' trumpet, groups, or plea.
units.risk: Response, repentance, ritual, quoted voice, nations, and outcome remain deferred.

units.title: Answer of removal, abundance, and ending shame
units.literary_form: turning, restorative oracle, and concentric calls
units.deciding_marker: The turning introduces provisions, removed host, rejoicing land/animals/Zion, rain, harvest, and no-shame reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach turn, host, addressees, rain, restored years, or closure.
units.risk: Aspect at 2:18, northern identity, rain/teacher, locust, timing, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Afterward outpouring, signs, day, and escape
units.literary_form: future oracle from outpouring through portents to remnant closure
units.deciding_marker: 'Afterward' starts repeated outpouring, signs, before-the-day clause, and escape formula as one oracle.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate recipients, signs, 2:32, or later reuse.
units.risk: Spirit, prophecy, signs, day, salvation, remnant, reuse, translation, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Nations judgment and direct coastal indictment
units.literary_form: judgment announcement and direct-address repayment oracle
units.deciding_marker: 'In those days' links restoration with judgment; verses 4-8 narrow to direct address but complete the indictment.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not sever accusation from judgment or atomize names, goods, acts, and repayments.
units.risk: Nations, valley, names, Greeks, violence, ethics, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Nations summoned to the valley and roar from Zion
units.literary_form: war summons, judicial-harvest scene, cosmic darkening, and refuge climax
units.deciding_marker: 'Proclaim' opens warriors, gathering, judicial sitting, harvest, valley refrain, signs, and Zion roar as one scene.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate implement reversal, harvest, valley refrain, signs, or refuge.
units.risk: War, valley, harvest, violence, cosmic language, refuge, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Zion dwelling, renewed land, contrasted desolation, and closure
